title: Replication or Corroboration? An Axiomatic Framework for Evidential Dependence in Multi-Agent Debate
abstract: arXiv:2610.36151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In multi-agent debates, matching reports can arise for two different reasons: agents may repeat the same evidence (replication), or they may provide separate evidential roots that support the same claim (corroboration). A judge must distinguish these two cases. Counting report occurrences gives extra weight to relays, paraphrases, alias resubmissions, and excerpt splits, while merging all matching content avoids this only by also removing genuine corroboration. We formalize this tension as a minimal judgment game in which acquiring new evidence is costly, but replication is cheap. We show that root replication invariance (RRI) is exactly threshold-uniform replication immunity. Under RRI, replication-only deviations cannot change the verdict, and positive-cost replication is strictly dominated, whereas occurrence-sensitive and content-keyed judges admit profitable deviations. translated_title: 复制还是印证？多智能体辩论中证据依赖性的公理化框架
translated_abstract: 在多智能体辩论中，匹配的报告可能出于两种不同的原因出现：智能体可能重复相同的证据（复制），或者他们可能提供各自独立的证据根源来支持同一主张（印证）。评判者必须区分这两种情况。按报告出现次数计数会给转述、改写、别名重复提交和片段拆分赋予额外权重，而将所有匹配内容进行合并虽然可以避免这一问题，却同时也消除了真正的印证。我们将这一矛盾形式化为一个最小判断博弈，其中获取新证据代价高昂，而复制却很廉价。我们证明，根源复制不变性恰好等价于阈值均匀复制免疫。在该性质下，仅由复制产生的偏差无法改变裁决结果，且具有正成本的复制策略被严格占优；而对出现次数敏感和基于内容键值的评判者则存在有利可图的偏差。我们还建立了一个信息边界：如果评判者可观测的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个公理化框架来区分多智能体辩论中的“复制”（重复相同证据）与“印证”（独立证据支持同一主张），并证明“根源复制不变性”性质能够确保仅靠复制行为无法改变评判者的裁决结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an axiomatic framework to distinguish "replication" (repeating the same evidence) from "corroboration" (independent evidence supporting the same claim) in multi-agent debate, proving that the "root replication invariance" (RRI) property guarantees that replication alone cannot alter a judge's verdict.
